CREATE TABLE "customers" (  -- 200 rows
  "customer_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY  -- unique id of the customer; e.g. '1', '2', '3',
  "name" TEXT  -- full name of the customer; e.g. 'Ananya Sharma', 'Ananya Singh', 'Ishaan Reddy',
  "city" TEXT  -- city where the customer lives; e.g. 'Bengaluru', 'Chennai', 'Pune',
  "segment" TEXT  -- customer type; values: Consumer, Corporate or Small Business; e.g. 'Consumer', 'Corporate', 'Small Business',
  "signup_date" TEXT  -- date the customer created an account; values: YYYY-MM-DD; e.g. '2025-10-09', '2025-03-31', '2025-08-27'
);

CREATE TABLE "order_items" (  -- 3268 rows
  "order_id" INTEGER  -- e.g. '1', '2', '3',
  "product_id" INTEGER  -- e.g. '10', '29', '39',
  "quantity" INTEGER  -- e.g. '1', '2', '3',
  "unit_price" REAL  -- e.g. '539.0', '529.0', '1069.0',
  PRIMARY KEY ("order_id", "product_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("product_id") REFERENCES "products"("product_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("order_id") REFERENCES "orders"("order_id")
);

CREATE TABLE "orders" (  -- 1500 rows
  "order_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY  -- unique id of the order; e.g. '1', '2', '3',
  "customer_id" INTEGER  -- the customer who placed the order; e.g. '100', '80', '105',
  "order_date" TEXT  -- date the order was placed; values: YYYY-MM-DD; e.g. '2026-10-18', '2026-08-15', '2026-08-09',
  "status" TEXT  -- current status of the order; values: completed = delivered and paid; cancelled = never paid; refunded = paid then money returned. Spending/revenue should only count completed orders.; e.g. 'completed', 'cancelled', 'refunded',
  "total_amount" REAL  -- order total in INR including all items; e.g. '539.0', '2127.0', '16273.0',
  FOREIGN KEY ("customer_id") REFERENCES "customers"("customer_id")
);

CREATE TABLE "payments" (  -- 1463 rows
  "payment_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY  -- unique id of the payment; e.g. '1', '2', '3',
  "order_id" INTEGER  -- order this payment belongs to; e.g. '1', '2', '3',
  "paid_at" TEXT  -- date the payment was made; values: YYYY-MM-DD; e.g. '2026-10-18', '2026-08-17', '2026-08-09',
  "amount" REAL  -- amount paid in INR; e.g. '539.0', '2127.0', '8136.5',
  "method" TEXT  -- how the customer paid; values: card, upi, netbanking or cod (cash on delivery); e.g. 'card', 'netbanking', 'upi',
  FOREIGN KEY ("order_id") REFERENCES "orders"("order_id")
);

CREATE TABLE "products" (  -- 40 rows
  "product_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY  -- e.g. '1', '2', '3',
  "name" TEXT  -- e.g. 'Wireless Earbuds', 'Smartwatch', 'Bluetooth Speaker',
  "category" TEXT  -- e.g. 'Electronics', 'Books', 'Home',
  "price" REAL  -- e.g. '7919.0', '1399.0', '7099.0'
);

FROM payments p
JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE
  c.city = 'Mumbai' AND o.status = 'completed'
